# MetrAIyux 0S Public Overview

MetrAIyux 0S is a founder-controlled company operating system with a public education layer, customer workspace layer, private admin command layer, approval gates, proof records, and a 16-brain routing model. The public overview explains the system, value, technical posture, security boundary, and fit route without publishing private setup or control material.

Key public concepts:
- Public overview and guided buyer education
- Customer SaaS workspace separation
- Private owner/admin command and approval surface
- 16 scoped brains, including Main Automation Brain and 0meg4kAI security/QA review
- Cloudflare-oriented edge architecture using static pages, workers, D1, KV, queues, and approval email patterns
- Proof-led operation through receipts, ledgers, policies, and smoke-check records

Public overview: https://metraiyux-0s-public-spectacle.pages.dev/

Full website route: https://metraiyux-0s-full-system.graylondonskyes.workers.dev/
